name: Layers — subject + background (SAM)
description: Splits one photo into two files from a single click: the subject with a real alpha channel, and the background plate with the subject cut away. Both keep the original size, so they recompose pixel-perfectly in any editor.

models.purpose: SAM ViT-B prompt-encoder + mask decoder (ONNX, CPU)

parameters.label: Points to the object (x,y;x,y — empty means centre)
Segmentation model
parameters.description: mobilesam = ViT-T, ~1.5 s on this CPU, fine for whole objects. vitb = ViT-B, about 4x slower, keeps hair, wire, fur and fingertips that ViT-T rounds off. Same 1024 frame, same prompts.

parameters.label: Which of the three masks
parameters.description: SAM always returns three candidate masks. largest = the whole object, which is what a cutout wants; auto = the model's own best-confidence pick, which on a clean subject is sometimes a sub-part (an eye, a buckle) because it is unambiguous at that scale.

notes: Nothing is reconstructed here: the background plate keeps the pixels the subject covered, just fully transparent, so subject + plate recompose to the original exactly. That makes this the honest alternative to inpainting when you want to move a subject rather than delete it.
